# London Fence Installer
London's trusted fence contractor serving London, St. Thomas, Woodstock, Tillsonburg, Strathroy, Aylmer, St. Marys, Ingersoll, Dorchester, and Thamesford in Southwestern Ontario.

## About
Locally owned and operated with 20 years of combined fencing experience. Free quotes within 48 hours. Five-year limited warranty on all installations. Fully insured. Serving residential and commercial clients.

## Services
- Wood fence installation (cedar, pressure-treated pine) — picket, privacy, horizontal, lattice, louver, post-and-rail styles
- Vinyl fence installation — EverGuard® systems, privacy, picket, corral rail styles
- Chain-link fencing — residential and commercial grades, dog runs, property enclosures
- Metal fence installation — ornamental aluminum and wrought iron, pool fencing, decorative
- Black aluminum fencing — powder-coated, pool code compliant, low-maintenance
- Fence repair — sagging fences, broken boards, rust, mould, vandalism
- Fence staining — cedar and pressure-treated pine, weather and UV protection
- Guardrail installation — road and highway safety barriers, property gates
- Noise wall and highway fencing — sound barrier walls, roadside delineation

## Service Area
London, St. Thomas, Woodstock, Aylmer, Strathroy, Tillsonburg, St. Marys, Ingersoll, Dorchester, Thamesford — Southwestern Ontario

## Pricing
- Wood fence installation: approximately $30–$60 per linear foot installed
- Vinyl fence installation: approximately $40–$70 per linear foot installed
- Chain-link fencing: approximately $15–$30 per linear foot installed
- Metal/aluminum fencing: approximately $35–$65 per linear foot installed
- Fence staining: approximately $1.50–$3.50 per linear foot
- Fence repair: approximately $150–$800 depending on damage type

## Key Differentiators
- Posts installed minimum 42 inches below grade to prevent frost heave
- 30 kg quick-setting concrete per post for maximum stability
- Free quotes within 48 hours
- Five-year limited warranty on all fence installations
- Cedar recommended for its natural insect-repelling properties and low maintenance
